amendment_rule: New status values are added to this spec by PR together with a conformance-test update. Producers must not emit values outside these enums.

authority_status.description: authority.status records the authorization standing at CVO construction.

causal_assessment.description: The causal judgment on the treatment-vs-control claim.
causal_assessment.rule: Only the verifier's recomputed value is a verdict. The executor-declared causal_assessment is a claim and never, by itself, exits NOT_PROVEN.

observation_status.description: observation.status mirrors the execution receipt's status for the observed action.
observation_status.rule: CAUSAL_SUPPORTED requires both treatment and control receipts at SUCCESS (the both_success gate). Any other status keeps the claim NOT_PROVEN.

verification_status.description: The outcome-verification verdict on the paired action outcomes.
verification_status.rule: Emitted only after independent recomputation confirms the outcomes. A CVO block without this field is NOT_PROVEN. (PAIRED_ACTION_OUTCOMES_NOT_VERIFIED is an edge-function error code, not a verification_status value.)

derived_from.method: descriptive-then-prescriptive: the enums below were read from what the producers actually emit at the pinned tip (no invented values); they are prescriptive going forward — producers must not emit values outside these enums

independence_invariant.rule: The verifier re-reads persisted receipts and gates validity on evidence-derived checks; the executor declared assessment is necessary but never sufficient. Two verifier styles satisfy this: nayanet-causal-verify re-validates the declared CVO against re-read receipts (declared values must match re-read evidence, including provenance checks); nayanet-causal-learning-experiment fully recomputes the assessment (recomputed_causal_assessment) and requires declared == recomputed.

not_proven.default: Every causal claim is NOT_PROVEN until a verifier emits a conforming CVO with causal_assessment=CAUSAL_SUPPORTED and verification_status=OUTCOME_VERIFIED via independent recomputation (verifier_mode AUTHORITATIVE_REREAD_AND_RECOMPUTATION, executor_claim_trusted=false).
exit_conditions: independent verification confirms the claim against re-read evidence
declared values match re-read evidence (declared_matches_recomputation where implemented)
identities and observations match the persisted receipts
non_exits: absence of a causal_verification block (verify mode returns CVO_NOT_PERSISTED, HTTP 409)

scope: The `causal_verification` block (schema NAYANET_CAUSAL_VERIFICATION_V1) persisted on nayanet_execution_receipts evidence, and the verifier's recomputation response. nayanet-learning-verify does not construct CVO blocks (it references causal_verification_id only). learning-verify declaration tags (LEARNING_VERIFIED, epistemic_state) are a separate axis and out of scope here.
title: CVO Outcome Axes — canonical verdict vocabulary for Causal Verification Objects
